items.title: America’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve Is Running on Fumes. What Happens When the Next Supply Shock Hits?
items.summary: The U.S. just used its emergency oil buffer to blunt a major supply shock, and it worked. But the strategy left America's strategic reserve at its lowest point in over four decades, and the next disruption could arrive before a single replacement barrel goes in the ground.

items.title: Shell’s Chemicals Exit Attracts XOM and LYB: Capital Discipline or Missed Opportunity?
items.summary: Shell plc (NYSE:SHEL) is considering selling its U.S. chemicals business, with potential buyers including ExxonMobil, LyondellBasell, Apollo and the chemicals arm of Kuwait Petroleum Corporation.
